description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Regal Caracal, adding {C}{C}.
Regal Caracal dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Regal Caracal from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Regal Caracal enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cat, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
